      "source": "gcc/final_permit.pdf",
      "locator": "Page: 5, Section: part_i, FLOATING SOLIDS OR VISIBLE FOAM",
      "exact_span": "There shall be no discharge of oils, scum, grease and other floating materials that would cause the formation of a visible sheen or visible deposits on the bottom or shoreline, or would damage or impair the normal growth, function or reproduction of human, animal, plant or aquatic life.",
      "affected_purpose": "A",
      "computation_change_reason": "Establishes a qualitative enforceable discharge standard rather than a numeric limit; interpretation of 'visible sheen', 'visible deposits', and 'damage or impair' determines whether Purpose A treats reported measurements as subject to numeric limit comparison or as non-numeric compliance evaluation."
    },
    {
      "source": "gcc/final_permit.pdf",
      "locator": "Page: 5, Section: part_i, B. REPORTING OF MONITORING RESULTS (MINOR DISCHARGERS)",
      "exact_span": "Discharge Monitoring Report (DMR) results shall be electronically reported to EPA per 40 CFR 127.16.",
      "affected_purpose": "B",
      "computation_change_reason": "Sets a baseline monitoring-reporting obligation; whether electronic DMR submission was required affects which monitoring requirements are deemed applicable for FY2025."
    },
    {
      "source": "gcc/final_permit.pdf",
      "locator": "Page: 5, Section: part_i, B. REPORTING OF MONITORING RESULTS (MINOR DISCHARGERS)",
      "exact_span": "Until approved for Net DMR, the permittee shall request temporary or emergency waivers from electronic reporting.",
      "affected_purpose": "B,C",
      "computation_change_reason": "Conditions electronic reporting on NetDMR approval status and a waiver process; different readings of whether approval or a waiver was in effect change whether reporting was required as stated or under an alternate authorized procedure, and thus what missing or alternate evidence means."
    },
    {
      "source": "gcc/final_permit.pdf",
      "locator": "Page: 5, Section: part_i, B. REPORTING OF MONITORING RESULTS (MINOR DISCHARGERS)",
      "exact_span": "If paper reporting is granted temporarily, the permittee shall submit the original DMR signed and certified as required by Part III.D.11 and all other reports required by Part III.D. to the EPA and copies to NMED as required (See Part III.D.IV of the permit ).",
      "affected_purpose": "B,C",
      "computation_change_reason": "Defines an alternate reporting pathway and required form, certification, and distribution when paper reporting is granted; interpretation of whether a temporary paper waiver applied changes applicable reporting obligations and whether available evidence satisfies the required submission standard."
    },
    {
      "source": "gcc/final_permit.pdf",
      "locator": "Page: 5, Section: part_i, B. REPORTING OF MONITORING RESULTS (MINOR DISCHARGERS)",
      "exact_span": "Monitoring information shall be submitted quarterly. Each quarterly submittal shall include separate forms for each month of the reporting period.",
      "affected_purpose": "B,C",
      "computation_change_reason": "Specifies quarterly monitoring submission frequency and that each month within a quarter must have its own form; interpretation affects which monitoring periods were required and whether partial or aggregated submissions count as adequate evidence."
    },
    {
      "source": "gcc/final_permit.pdf",
      "locator": "Page: 5, Section: part_i, B. REPORTING OF MONITORING RESULTS (MINOR DISCHARGERS), item 1",
      "exact_span": "Reporting periods shall end on the last day of the months March, June, September, and December.",
      "affected_purpose": "B,C",
      "computation_change_reason": "Defines the calendar boundaries of quarterly reporting periods that intersect Federal FY2025; different period assignment changes which months' monitoring was due and whether absent data reflects a not-yet-due period versus missing required evidence."
    },
    {
      "source": "gcc/final_permit.pdf",
      "locator": "Page: 5, Section: part_i, B. REPORTING OF MONITORING RESULTS (MINOR DISCHARGERS), item 2",
      "exact_span": "The permittee is required to submit regular quarterly reports as described above postmarked no later than the 28th day of the month following each reporting period.",
      "affected_purpose": "B,C",
      "computation_change_reason": "Sets the submission deadline relative to each reporting period; interpretation of postmark timing determines whether monitoring was required by a given FY2025 date and whether late versus absent submissions should be classified as missing required evidence."
    }
  ]
}
